content.what_it_is: SEDIMENT-conditional suspended-load and morphodynamics implementation. `eval_sed_load` computes water depth, settling/pickup and either an upwind concentration update or three-stage reconstruction/Riemann updates (L8-L184). `sediment_solver`, `sediment_source`, and `sediment_flux` form the staged transport path (L186-L474). `update_bed` accumulates source rates over Morph_step, updates Zb, and repeatedly relaxes x/y avalanche slopes (L476-L884).
entities: eval_sed_load with ISTEP/ISTAGE and Dstar/viscosity plus GLOBAL sediment, flux, depth and mask arrays around L8-L184
sediment_solver with ISTEP, n_left/n_right/n_bottom/n_top, face flux/source scalars and RS array around L186-L221
sediment_source with Dstar/viscosity and GLOBAL pickup/deposition variables around L223-L283
sediment_flux with reconstructed concentration/gradient/state arrays and HLL face fluxes around L286-L474
update_bed with ISTEP and GLOBAL counters, averaged rates, bed arrays, avalanche flags and scratch around L476-L884

equations.ref: left-neighbor shear velocity using east-neighbor depth
x-face depth assembled with cell-centered bed array

calls: eval_sed_load calls sediment_flux, sediment_source, sediment_solver and EXCHANGE around L169-L174
sediment_flux calls DERIVATIVE_X_High/Y_High, CONSTRUCT_HO_X/Y, WAVE_SPEED and HLLC around L296-L365
update_bed performs no exchange after neighbor-mutating avalanche passes through L884
unresolved: Neighbor shear velocities ustar_c1 through ustar_c4 all use MAX(H(I+1,J),MinDepth) around L38-L42, even for center, west, north and south velocities. The surrounding k1-k4 formulas use direction-matched depths, exposing this as a copy/paste location defect that feeds all diffusion coefficients.

The positive-V F4 diffusion branch uses H(I,J+1)+H(I,J) while its concentration difference and face velocity are on the south face J-1; the negative branch uses H(I,J-1)+H(I,J). This sign-dependent geometry mismatch changes diffusion solely with flow direction.

For px==1, the x wall block's IF(npx==0) ... ELSEIF(npx==px-1) executes only the west condition and skips the east condition. The y block has an explicit py==1 case setting both sides, confirming the x single-partition omission.

Both deposition implementations evaluate (1-n_porosity)/CH before multiplication by CH, with no CH>0 guard. Active wet cells can have CH=0 initially or after MAX clamping in sediment_solver, so division by zero precedes any algebraic cancellation.

The direct upwind path updates CH without nonnegative or upper-concentration clipping, while sediment_solver clamps both bounds. Selecting Sed_Scheme therefore changes not only discretization but admissible concentration handling.

sediment_flux calls CONSTRUCT_HO_X/Y with an extra DX/DY actual argument around L300-L309. The independently read fluxes.F definitions of CONSTRUCT_HO_X/Y omit spacing arguments, while only the `_minmod` variants accept them. Without an alternate explicit interface at link time, these calls shift every subsequent argument and violate the procedure ABI.

sediment_flux forms HxL/HxR (Mloc1 by Nloc) and HyL/HyR (Mloc by Nloc1) by adding whole Zb, whose cell-centered shape is Mloc by Nloc. No face reconstruction or slice is applied to Zb, producing shape/interface inconsistency or wrong bed placement at faces.
Pickup formulas divide by Tau_cr and c_b and logarithmic shear denominators without guarding zero or singular values. D50, Shields_cr, Sdensity and water depth input domains are not validated here.

The avalanche pass updates I-1/J-1 neighbors in-place and jumps back to label 96 after each correction, restarting the entire scan until a hard 1000-restart cap. Results depend on alternating traversal order and may exit with slopes still above tan_phi without reporting nonconvergence.

Avalanche reads and writes ghost-adjacent I-1/J-1 cells but update_bed performs no halo exchange inside or after the iterative relaxation. Cross-partition bed slopes can therefore use stale halos and diverge between decompositions.

Morph_step is used as both equality trigger and divisor without a positivity check. If it is zero, averaging divides by zero; if Counter_s is not initialized/reset consistently, the NE test can miss the sole equality trigger.
